father of Mary Anderson Morshead

Brother of the Rev.

John Philip Anderson Morshead, he was first cousin to WCY and to the Rev.

John Yonge of Puslinch.

Described as half-pay captain Royal Artillery in 1861 census, he married (1843) Charlotte Story (1823/4-1888).
